summary: PyRIT took the scoring objective from any text piece in the previous turn, so text from a tool or simulated turn could become the objective given to the scorer (ETB-02)
details:
`extract_objective_from_previous_turn_async` in `pyrit/score/message_scorer.py`, and its deprecated sync twin, build the scoring objective from the turn before the scored message. They selected the pieces of that turn by data type only (`text`). A tool piece or a simulated piece in that turn therefore supplied the objective. When a user piece was also there, the other text was joined to the user's request. The pull request shows a stored conversation whose previous turn is a tool piece: that text comes back as the objective. It says the path is reached through the deprecated `infer_objective_from_request=True` option and through the scorer evaluator's harm-dataset path. This is ETB-02 (unsanitized model output in the evaluator prompt): text that is not the request, including tool output, flowed into the objective the scorer judges against.

The page shows the wrong objective being extracted. It does not show a scorer's verdict changing.

Fix: pull request #3322 (opened 2026-10-18, merged 2026-10-20) keeps only pieces whose role is `user`. A previous turn with no user piece now gives an empty objective. Tests cover six non-user roles in the sync and async forms. The fix was first released in pyrit 1.2.0 (PyPI, 2026-11-13). Release 1.1.0 (2026-09-04) does not contain it.

database_specific.note: 'introduced: 0' is a conservative bound; releases before 1.1.0 were not checked. Git tag v1.1.0 has the data-type-only filter in `pyrit/score/message_scorer.py` and does not contain the fix commit. Tag v1.2.0 contains it (GitHub compare, 2026-11-13, with the tag at commit 5398ad19). PyPI lists pyrit 1.2.0, uploaded 2026-11-13. `pyrit/score/message_scorer.py` in the 1.2.0 wheel has the same SHA-256 as the file at that commit.

target.name: PyRIT scoring objective extraction
target.affected_component_versions: pyrit 1.1.0, and later commits before 85d4f0c3 (2026-10-20); earlier releases not checked. Fixed in pyrit 1.2.0

attack.description: A stored conversation has a tool or simulated piece at the turn before the scored message. Its text is returned as the scoring objective, alone or joined to the user's request.
attack.preconditions: A caller that takes the objective from the previous turn: the deprecated `infer_objective_from_request=True` option or the scorer evaluator's harm-dataset path, as the pull request states. The effect on a scorer's verdict was not measured on the page.
attack.poc_pointer: test_filters_previous_sequence_by_role_async in tests/unit/score/test_message_scorer.py, added by pull request #3322 (extraction level).

hardening.fix: Build the objective only from user-role pieces of the previous turn; return an empty objective when there is none.
hardening.pattern: Escape or structurally neutralize model output before it enters any grader prompt; use message-role separation (taxonomy ETB-02 fix pattern).
hardening.residual_risk: The objective is still inferred from stored conversation text on the two paths the pull request names.

disclosure.tier_reason: Public artifact, no non-public information, impact limited to the scorer's objective and verdict, fix supplied with the report.
disclosure.notes: Reported as pull request #3322 from the AUTHENSOR account, carrying the fix. A maintainer asked for changes on 2026-10-19, added a commit with tests for the fix, approved on 2026-10-20 and merged it. The merged commit lists the maintainer as a co-author.
